dedupe_keys.name: trnsys type 842 model for the transient simulation of bulk pcm tanks with immersed fin and tube heat exchanger version 2 0

description: Andreas Heinz at the Institute of Thermal Engineering, Graz University of Technology, publishes version 2.0 of TRNSYS Type 842 for transient thermal-storage simulation. The model represents a rectangular phase-change-material tank charged and discharged through an immersed fin-and-tube heat exchanger. It can support analysis and sizing of heat-storage components without a fixed geographical coverage or calendar period. Heat conduction within the PCM is considered only along the direction of the tubes. Consequently, the model applies only to heat exchangers with small distances between tubes, subject to the detailed documentation. The repository metadata dates model development from December 2007 to November 2022 and publication to 8 November 2022. It assigns the MIT licence, while restricting file access: the named contact supplies a download link on request. No charge is stated, and the public metadata does not expose the package format. Related Type 840 models describe a different storage arrangement; this record retains the separate Type 842 identity.
